## What it does

A suite of 21 Bayesian models pairing nitrogen analytes with environmental predictors. Effects are summarized with marginaleffects and published as Quarto reports.

## Highlights

- Model fits are precomputed, so reports render quickly without saving large brms objects
- A reusable function computes predictor effects on the original data scale
